title_en: 3-STOREY VILLA FOR SALE IN THE AREA OF SKOZA
description_en: Villa for sale in the area of ​​Shkoza, 2 minutes from the big ring road. - The villa is located in a residential area. - In total, there is 640 m2 of construction and 479.8 m2 of land area. - On the -1st floor there is a closed garage and a storage room. - On the 0th floor, with individual access separated from the rest of the villa, there is an open space commercial space for events with a kitchen and 2 toilets with a total area of ​​272.3 m2. - On the first residential floor; - there is a veranda, - living room, - 2 bedrooms, - separate kitchen - bathroom with a total area of ​​148.8 m2. - On the second floor there are the same spaces but with a total area of ​​137.9 m2. - The two residential floors have external stairs as well as internal stairs. - The villa is covered with the German standard kapot system to ensure the maximum thermal insulation that this technology enables. -- The windows are with thermal duplex duralumin. - For sale furnished as in the photo - For more information or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us.
